ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast observed between high-intensity white central regions and low-intensity black/dark-grey peripheral and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the central and upper regions of both lobes. Significant dark mottling and solid dark banding are concentrated at the lower central junction (peduncle attachment) and along the trailing edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle estimated at approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serrations are present. The right lobe displays prominent, sharp peaks (saw-tooth pattern) while the left lobe shows more irregular, moderately rounded peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping upwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, roughly circular high-contrast white textured clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, roughly parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-right lobe surface, cutting through the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged serration and missing segments along the trailing edge indicative of physical trauma; heavy barnacle encrustation at both lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small dark focal spots localized on the lower interior portion of the left lobe near the central notch.
